item.text:
It provides order utilities: totals item `price × qty`, applies two discount codes, calculates an average, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the final access is `items[items.length]` (`undefined`), causing a `TypeError`. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides an order total (which includes quantities) by number of distinct lines, so it is not an average per item when `qty > 1`.
- `averageItemPrice([])` returns `NaN` (and currently also hits the `calcTotal` crash).
